audio: Los Angeles, 1957. Sputnik crossed the sky, and four women asked: who would support America’s next generation of scientists?
visual: Stylized Sputnik crosses a dark field above a Los Angeles 1957 title card.

purpose: Name the founders and frame the alliance
audio: Florence Malouf, Irene Slagel, Alice Tyler, and Helene Wooldridge sought counsel from Caltech president Lee DuBridge—an alliance, in our telling, of egg heads and socialites.
visual: Four founder names resolve on archival-style index cards with Caltech and editorial-framing labels.
source: ARCS Los Angeles history page; phrase is user-supplied editorial framing

purpose: Mark incorporation and the first membership
audio: On September 5, 1958, Achievement Rewards for College Scientists was incorporated in California. Soon, 53 philanthropic leaders formed its first membership, connecting civic leadership with scientific possibility.
visual: Illustrated incorporation paper transitions into 53 points and a final source-credit bridge.
